arms.name: language_aware_ingest
arms.description: Per-chunk language with confidence and sentence splitting by the chunk's language (LANG-05, LANG-06); judged per language.

arms.name: table_header_repeat
arms.description: The header row repeated in every table chunk in every processing profile (CHK-06).

arms.name: table_row_serialization
arms.description: "column = value" row serialization for the embedding and lexical text of table chunks (CHK-07).

arms.name: caption_language
arms.description: Image captions written in the document's language (XLG-06); judged on the image items per language.

arms.name: doc_translation
arms.description: Retrieval-only chunk translations over query translation alone (XLG-04); judged on cross_lingual per language pair. Optional: it needs the translation producer run between the build and the eval.

notes: No BGE-M3 arm: comparing that profile belongs to Phase 3.2.1 (plan 03.2.1-03), which runs after this phase.
Ingestion-side arms rebuild the fixture tenant for each run, so the off and on runs differ only in the switch; the retrieval settings are the eval pin.
The caption arm runs with the recorded fixture captioner, which returns the same caption in every language, so its fixture runs can only prove wiring.
